Parent final source exception produces a failed launcher receipt; worker final source exception preserves both original failure and final source error, with zero native strokes.
Conflicting tracing hook is restored to the original function and refuses acceptance.
Saved scientific payload verifier checks declared history digest, bounded gzip size, exact trace hashes, per-prefix counts and cell-query count, and equality of all phase trace payloads.

limits: Mocked orchestration success does not establish actual whole-history numerical parity or timing improvement.
